name: Roman amphitheatre of El Jem
heritage: World Heritage Site; listed monument of Tunisia
text: The Amphitheatre of El Jem (Arabic: قصر الجم, romanized: Qaṣr al-Jamm) is an oval amphitheatre in the modern-day city of El Djem, Tunisia, formerly Thysdrus in the Roman province of Africa. It has been listed by UNESCO since 1979 as a World Heritage Site.

depictions.name: Amphitheatre
depictions.text: The Amphitheatre is an unconstructible building in Age of Empires II HD: The Forgotten. It is purely decorative and has no actual use in-game, and is only available in the Scenario Editor.
